status: Main demand-allocation assumption approved in chat; pilot station assignment unresolved; simulation not implemented

main_allocation.interpretation: Each fictional case is independently assigned to one pilot barangay with equal probability. Realized counts can differ within a run; exactly 20% per run is not required.

pairing_rule: Generate barangay assignments once per replication with a recorded seed and reuse identical assignments across policies. Do not redraw within each policy.
claim: Synthetic cases are allocated equally in probability across the selected barangays. This is an experimental assumption, not an estimate of actual local births.

optional_sensitivity.formula: p_i = population_2024_i / sum(population_2024_j for selected pilot barangays)
optional_sensitivity.limit: Total population is a proxy assumption, not postpartum demand. Keep total arrivals/resources fixed across allocation scenarios and pair policies within each scenario.

station_assignment.reason: All current five reference points are closer to Linao West in screened geometry; no official catchments established. Old proposed demo grouping is not approved by this demand allocation decision.

implementation_gate: Before policy simulation, document station allocation and travel assumptions. Recalculate equal weights as 1 / pilot count if pilot membership changes.
